title: The Patient Cellar
author: Rosalind Ravensworth
blurb: Theo Coldharbour, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
